description: Na₇MgSbO₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of three Na₇MgSbO₆ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.43 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.41 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.41 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 1.96 Å. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Sb-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mg atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Sb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Sb square pyramids.
